correctness.rationale: An explicit expectation sum over injections, uniform-subset conditioning on a vacant right label, and indicator covariance yield the exact ratio. Strict concavity of 1 minus the left-degree product proves unique real sign change and every boundary case; a 638-identity rational check and seven exhaustive finite models independently corroborate the exact computations. Finite checks are not substituted for the all-parameter proof.

value.rationale: The theorem gives a finite-size dependence law for arbitrary non-induced motif and heterogeneous independent row-degree profiles, with complete strict sign regimes and a distinctive exact square threshold for overlapping stars. It isolates meaningful structural information lost in marginal motif or vacancy expectations; it is neither a routine single numerical example nor an arbitrary parameter slice.
